agents.name: INFRA
agents.bullseye: CI that catches real breaks, never false alarms.
agents.mission: CI, workflows, branch protection: the mechanical gates that never sleep.
why_not_10: The CI test red reproduces locally and is masked by workflow line 65's 'exit 0' — a gate that cannot fail is theater.
/tmp is a 512MB tmpfs: a full disk silently corrupts full-suite batteries (phantom REDs) — the disk-isolation discipline (TMPDIR + repointed mktemp) is not the default path.
The adversarial harness and the pytest battery share /tmp — concurrent runs corrupt each other (SN-0796); they must be serialized or disk-isolated by default.
agents.next_action: Fix the CI workflow's swallowed exit codes (the line-65 class) so a red is always a real red, then prove the full suite green on a clean runner.
